caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest placed against a plain beige background with faint horizontal and vertical guideline shadows indicating the surface and wall behind it. The chest is primarily reddish-brown, resembling polished wood, and features detailed carved designs on its front and visible side panels. The carvings on the front consist of symmetrical patterns with two large, arching semicircular motifs enclosing teardrop and swirling shapes, bordered with additional geometric etchings. Vertical rows of small, round indentations line the visible corner edges. The chest has a flat, overhanging lid and a central metallic lock plate with a keyhole on the front panel. The top and sides of the chest are smooth, while the carved patterns provide decorative texture on the front and side. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the lightly written text "Anne Ger" appears.
title: Box
